evals.prompt: Plan a multi-task migration in this scoped module to adopt a current external SDK/framework feature and idiomatic error-handling pattern not yet present in the repo.
evals.expected_output: The agent explores in-scope repo files first, performs targeted web search when external API/framework/domain knowledge is needed, prioritizes official documentation, established best practices, and high-ranking GitHub repositories, and grounds planned tasks and file paths in the scoped repo.
assertions: Explores in-scope repository context within scope_boundaries.allowed
Uses web search for external API, framework, or domain research when repo context is insufficient
Prioritizes official documentation first, then established best practices and high-ranking GitHub repositories
Does not let external best practices override repo-specific conventions or add unrelated scope creep

evals.prompt: Plan a multi-task refactor of internal module interfaces where all types, callers, and tests already exist inside the active scope.
evals.expected_output: The agent grounds the plan in inspected repo code without unnecessary external web research or generic best-practice ceremony tasks.
assertions: Grounds tasks, symbols, and verification commands in inspected repository code
Skips unnecessary web search when in-scope repository evidence is complete
Does not add generic best-practice tasks unrelated to the requested outcome

evals.prompt: Route a single-symptom failing test fix versus a multi-task architectural migration, and show the approved handoff block for a persisted plan.
evals.expected_output: Routes the single-symptom bug directly to $dot:bug without creating a plan file, and for the approved multi-task plan outputs a handoff to $dot:implement with the repo-root-relative .plans/plan_<timestamp>.md path, plan_id, and revision.
assertions: Routes bounded symptom-driven debugging to $dot:bug and bounded refactors to $dot:refactor
Includes plan_id and revision in the approved $dot:implement handoff block
Allows ## Scope ahead of ## Plan when the Workflow Gate activates $dot:scope first
